title: Values of straight-line operands
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $ss$ be a list of straight-line statements on $n$ inputs, and let $x$ be a Boolean assignment to those inputs. Suppose that for every $j$ less than the length of $ss$, the value at vertex $2n+j$ in the gate list for $ss$ equals the value at position $j$ in the execution of $ss$ on $x$ (with an out-of-range list position interpreted as false). Then every operand $o$ that is available before $ss$ has the same value in that gate list at its associated vertex as it has when evaluated on $x$ and the execution values of $ss$.
hypotheses_covered: For every $j<|ss|$, the gate value at vertex $2n+j$ equals the execution value at position $j$
